questions.question: Which of the following Provisions of the Indian Constitution is taken from the US Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**Post of vice president.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The provision of the post of **vice president** in the Indian Constitution is taken from the **US Constitution.**
 
• The vice president of India is the** second-highest constitutional office** in the country and is elected indirectly by an **Electoral College** consisting of members of both houses of Parliament.
 
• The **US Constitution** also provides for a vice president who serves as the second-in-command to the **President **and is elected through a similar Electoral College system.
 
• The Indian Constitution also draws inspiration from other constitutions, such as the **British Constitution, the Irish Constitution, and the Australian Constitution.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental duties** are a unique provision of the Indian Constitution that was added through the **42ⁿd Amendment in 1976.**
 
• It imposes certain obligations on citizens to uphold the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India, and to promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood among all people.
 
• **The procedure for amendment of constitution **is also a unique provision of the Indian Constitution that outlines the steps required to amend the Constitution.
 
• It requires a special majority of both houses of Parliament, as well as** ratification **by at least half of the state legislatures.
 
• **Bicameralism **refers to the division of the legislature into two houses - the **Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha** in the case of India.
 
• This is not a provision that is taken from the **US Constitution**, as the US has a unicameral legislature consisting of a single House of Representatives and a Senate.

questions.question: What is the nominal GDP if the real GDP is 500 and the price index is 150?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**750.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this question, the** real GDP** is given as** 500 **and the **price index** is given as **150.**
 
• To calculate the nominal GDP, we need to multiply the real GDP by the price index and **divide by 100.**
 
• Hence, the nominal GDP would be **(500 x 150) / 100 = 750.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nominal GDP** refers to the monetary value of all **final goods and services** produced within a country's borders during a specified period.
 
• **Real GDP** is an inflation-adjusted measure of a country's** economic output.**
 
• **GDP** calculates the monetary worth of **finished goods and services**—those purchased by the end user—that are generated in a nation during a specific time period.

questions.question: How many digits does the MMID code of any commercial bank have?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**7.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **MMID code** of any commercial bank has** 7 digits.**
 
• MMID stands for **Mobile Money Identifier.**
 
• It is a unique** 7-digit code** assigned by banks to their customers for mobile banking transactions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Every mobile banking account has a **distinct MMID** that the bank assigns to the user.
 
• There can only be **one MMID Code** associated with a bank account.
 
• To transfer money using this function, an MMID is required for both the** sender and the recipient.**
 
• To take advantage of this service, one must register for **mobile banking services **with your bank.

questions.question: What are the events in powerlifting?

options.text: Squats, bench press and dead lift
Squats, lat pull down and curl
Curls, over arm lift and dead lift

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Squats, bench press and dead lift.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Powerlifting **is a **strength sport** that involves lifting as much weight as possible in three different exercises: **squats, bench press, and deadlift.**
 
• These exercises are collectively known as the **"big three"** in powerlifting.
 
• Squats involve lifting a** barbell on your shoulders** and **lowering your body** until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
 
• This exercise primarily targets your **quadriceps, glutes, and hamstrings.**
 
• Bench press involves lying on a **bench and lifting **a barbell off a rack, lowering it to your chest, and then pressing it back up.
 
• This exercise primarily targets your **chest, shoulders, and triceps.**
 
• Deadlift involves lifting a** barbell off the ground **and standing up with it.
 
• This exercise primarily targets your **lower back, glutes, and hamstrings.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The sport known as** "odd lifts"** gave rise to powerlifting.
 
• It was based on the** same three-attempt pattern **but featured a wider range of events, similar to strongman competition.
 
• **Odd lifts** eventually became the **current three standard lifts.**
 
• Lifts may be performed **equipped or unequipped** during competition.
 
• In this context, "equipment" is a supporting **bench shirt, briefs, or a squat/deadlift suit.**

questions.question:
Identify the correct match. 

A) Pension to retired government employees - Revenue Receipt

B) Purchase of Machinery in Railways - Capital Expenditure
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only B.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The purchase of machinery in** Railways** is a **Capital Expenditure** as it involves the acquisition of a **fixed asset** that will be used over a period of time to generate revenue for the **Railways.**
 
• **Capital Expenditure **refers to the expenditure incurred on acquiring or improving fixed assets such as **land, buildings, machinery, **etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Revenue Expenditure** refers to the expenditure incurred on the day-to-day running of the business or government.
 
• They are essentially the same as **operating expenses **(OPEX) because they comprise all of the costs necessary to cover the** business's present operating costs.**
 
• Pension to retired government employees is a Revenue Expenditure as it is a recurring expense for the government.

questions.question: Which of the following has Kharif crops only?

• **Kharif crops** are those crops that are sown in the **rainy season** and harvested in the **winter season.**
 
• They require **high rainfall** and** warm temperature** for their growth.
 
• **Cotton and paddy** are two major Kharif crops that are widely grown in India.

• Maize is a **summer crop**, while peas are grown in both** Kharif and Rabi** seasons.
 
• **Barley and gram** are Rabi crops.
 
• These are sown in the **winter season** and harvested in the summer season.
 
• **Mustard **is also a **Rabi crop.**
 
• It is grown in the** winter season**.

questions.question: Which of the following classification bases of industry applies to the products - cotton, jute, wool, silk textile, rubber, tea, sugar, coffee, and edible oil?

• **Key industries **are those industries that are considered crucial for the growth and development of an economy, such as **steel, petroleum, and automobile industries.**
 
• **Consumer industries** are those industries that produce goods and services for direct consumption by individuals, such as **food, clothing, and entertainment industries.**
 
• **Mineral-based industries **are those industries that rely on the extraction and processing of minerals and ores, such as **mining and metallurgical** industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cotton** is a natural fiber that is derived from the cotton plant and is used to produce** textiles and clothing.**
 
• **Rubber** is a natural polymer that is derived from the **sap of the rubber tree** and is used to produce various products, including **tires, footwear, and industrial **products.
 
• **Tea, coffee, and sugar** are agricultural products that are grown and harvested for consumption as **beverages and sweeteners.**
 
• **Edible oil **is a cooking oil that is derived from various plant sources, including **soybeans, sunflowers, and palm** trees.

questions.question: In the 1930s, which of the following theories was propounded by Arthur Holmes about the mantle?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Convectional Current Theory.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arthur Holmes** propounded the **Convectional Current Theory** about the mantle in the **1930s.**
 
• This theory suggests that the mantle is in **constant motion** due to convection currents caused by the heat generated by the core.
 
• The theory explains the **movement of tectonic plates **and the formation of features like** mid-ocean ridges** and subduction zones.
 
• The theory was a significant contribution to the** field of geology **and helped explain many geological phenomena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Theory of Faunal Succession**:

 
 
• This theory is related to the **study of fossils **and suggests that the relative ages of rocks can be determined based on the fossils they contain.
 
• **William Smith** was the first to recognize the principle at the start of the 1800s.
 
 
 
• **Slab Pull Theory**:
 
 
• This theory explains the **movement of tectonic plates** due to the weight of the subducting plate pulling the rest of the plate along.
 
• **Harry Hess **first suggested this idea after using echo sounding to map out the topology of the ocean basins. 
 
 
 
• **Theory of Faulting:**
 
 
• This theory explains the** formation of faults** and how they contribute to the movement of tectonic plates.
 
• **Michael Balint **proposed the Basic Fault Theory.

• It is home to the **Eastern Naval Command **of the Indian Navy, which has the necessary infrastructure to host the** Harbour phase of SIMBEX-2022****.**
 
• **SIMBEX** is an **annual bilateral naval exercise** conducted between the **Indian Navy **and the **Republic of Singapore Navy** (RSN) since **1993.**
 
• The exercise aims to enhance mutual cooperation and interoperability between the two navies, and includes a range of activities such as **air defense, anti-submarine warfare, maritime security, and search and rescue operations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guwahati** is a city in the northeastern state of **Assam** and does not have a coast or a naval base.
 
• **Kolkata** is a city in the eastern state of **West Bengal **and although it has a port, it is primarily a** commercial port **and not a naval base.
 
• **Koch** is a city in the southern state of **Kerala **and does have a naval base, but it is primarily used for training and does not have the infrastructure to host a large-scale naval exercise like SIMBEX.

questions.question:

Such kind of freedom is provided in which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 19.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 19** of the Indian Constitution provides the freedom to practice any **profession, occupation, trade, or business.**
 
• **Article 18 **deals with the **abolition of titles,** whereas **Article 17 **abolishes** untouchability.**
 
• **Article 16** talks about **equality of opportunity** in matters of public employment.
 
• The Constitution of India guarantees various** fundamental rights to its citizens**, including the right to freedom of speech and expression, the right to life and liberty, the right to equality, the right to education, and the right against exploitation.
 
• The** freedom of trade and commerce** is an essential part of the right to livelihood, which is a fundamental right under Article 21 of the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 14 **of the Indian Constitution guarantees equality before the law and equal protection of the law to all persons.
 
• **Article 15 **prohibits **discrimination **on the grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
 
• **Article 21A** provides the right to education to all children between the ages of** six and fourteen years.**
 
• **Article 23** prohibits **trafficking** in human beings and forced labor.

questions.question: Which of these is one of the seven priorities adopted in the Union Budget for the fiscal year 2023-24?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Inclusive development**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Inclusive development **is a priority that focuses on ensuring that **economic growth** benefits all segments of **society, including marginalized and vulnerable groups.**
 
• Inclusive development aims to **reduce inequalities **and **promote social justice** by providing access to education, healthcare, and other basic services to all citizens.
 
• Inclusive development also seeks to create **employment opportunities **and promote **entrepreneurship,** particularly in rural areas and among women and youth.
 
• The adoption of inclusive development as one of the** seven priorities in the Union Budget** for the fiscal year** 2023-24** demonstrates the government's commitment to building an** equitable and sustainable economy** that benefits all citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In order to steer the nation toward **"Amrit Kaal,**" the **Union Budget for FY 2023–2024** adopts the seven priorities known as **Saptarishi.**
 
• This serves as a model for an** empowered and inclusive** economy.
 
• The budget "Saptarishi" has** seven **key areas of focus:
 
 
• youth power, green growth, inclusive development, infrastructure, and investment, reaching the last mile, and the financial sector.

questions.question: Which of the following nutrients is available mainly in apples?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**K.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Potassium (K) **is the nutrient that is available mainly in** apples.**
 
• Apples are a good source of potassium, which is an essential mineral required for various bodily functions such as **heart health, nerve function, and muscle contraction.**
 
• Apples are also a good source of **fiber, vitamin C, and antioxidants** that can help promote overall health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cobalt **is required in trace amounts for the production of **vitamin B12** in the body.

 
 
• Vitamin B12, which aids in the synthesis of** red blood cells,** contains cobalt. 
 
 
 
• **Apples **are **low in sodium **and can be a good addition to a low-sodium diet.
 
 
• The body needs sodium, an essential nutrient, to keep **bodily fluids balanced** and to maintain **healthy muscles and neurons.**
 
 
 
• **Sulfur** is required for the production of certain **amino acids** and proteins in the body.
 
 
• Sulfur is necessary for the body to assemble and** repair DNA** and shield cells from harm that could result in life-threatening conditions like** cancer. **
